&&\n                           quest_id.is_a?(String) && !quest_id.empty?\n\n    completed = payload['completed']\n    return [:invalid] unless completed.is_a?(Array) && completed.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) }\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, status, milestones_json, completed_json FROM campaign_quests WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [quest_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      _, status, milestones_json, completed_json = row\n      milestones = JSON.parse(milestones_json)\n      done = JSON.parse(completed_json)\n\n      completed.each do |m|\n        done << m if milestones.include?(m) && !done.include?(m)\n      end\n\n      milestones_done = milestones.count { |m| done.include?(m) }\n      new_status = (milestones_done == milestones.length && milestones.length > 0) ? 'completed' : status\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE campaign_quests SET status = ?, completed_json = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_status, JSON.generate(done), quest_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => quest_id,\n        'status' => new_status,\n        'milestones_total' => milestones.length,\n        'milestones_done' => milestones_done\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.summary(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      active = 0\n      completed = 0\n      blocked = 0\n\n      d.execute('SELECT status FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id).each do |row|\n        status = row[0]\n        case status\n        when 'active' then active += 1\n        when 'completed' then completed += 1\n        when 'blocked' then blocked += 1\n        end\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'active' => active,\n        'completed' => completed,\n        'blocked' => blocked\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_quest(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    title = payload['title']\n    status = payload['status']\n    milestones = payload['milestones']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      title.is_a?(String) && !title.empty? &&\n                      status.is_a?(String) && VALID_STATUSES.include?(status) &&\n                      milestones.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      milestones.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) && !m.empty? }\n\n    {\n      id: id,\n      title: title,\n      status: status,\n      milestones: milestones,\n      completed: []\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_quest\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Factions and NPCs: campaign relationship tracking\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Factions\n  def self.create_faction(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_faction(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_factions WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_factions (id, campaign_id, name, stance) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:name], data[:stance]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'stance' => data[:stance]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_npc(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_npc(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      faction_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_factions WHERE id = ? AND f.stance = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'friendly']\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'factions' => factions,\n        'npcs' => npcs,\n        'friendly_npcs' => friendly_npcs\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_faction(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    stance = payload['stance']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      stance.is_a?(String) && !stance.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, stance: stance }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_faction\n\n  def self.validate_npc(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    faction_id = payload['faction_id']\n    disposition = payload['disposition']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      faction_id.is_a?(String) && !faction_id.empty? &&\n                      disposition.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    { id: id, name: name, faction_id: faction_id, disposition: disposition }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_npc\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Inventory and equipment: campaign inventory and character assignments\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Inventory\n  def self.add_item(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    item_slug = payload['item_slug']\n    quantity = payload['quantity']\n    owner = payload['owner']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless item_slug.is_a?(String) && !item_slug.empty? &&\n                             owner.is_a?(String) && !owner.empty? &&\n                             quantity.is_a?(Integer) && quantity > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n         ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, item_slug, owner) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'item_slug' => item_slug,\n        'quantity' => quantity,\n        'owner' => owner\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                             character_id.is_a?(String) && !character_id.empty?\n\n    item_slug = payload['item_slug']\n    quantity = payload['quantity']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless item_slug.is_a?(String) && !item_slug.empty? &&\n                             quantity.is_a?(Integer) && quantity > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      character_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [character_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless character_exists\n\n      party_qty = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n      )\n      next [:invalid] unless party_qty.is_a?(Integer) && party_qty >= quantity\n\n      new_party_qty = party_qty - quantity\n      if new_party_qty == 0\n        d.execute(\n          'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n      else\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [new_party_qty, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n      end\n\n      existing_assigned = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n      )\n      if existing_assigned\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = quantity + ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n      else\n        d.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n        )\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'character_id' => character_id,\n        'item_slug' => item_slug,\n        'quantity' => quantity\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.summary(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      party_rows = d.execute(\n        'SELECT item_slug, quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n\n      assigned_count = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n\n      result = {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'party_items' => party_rows.length,\n        'assigned_items' => assigned_count\n      }\n\n      party_rows.each do |slug, qty|\n        base = slug.to_s\n        plural = base.end_with?('s') ? base : base + 's'\n        result[plural.gsub('-', '_') + '_available'] = qty\n      end\n\n      [:ok, result]\n    end\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Downtime crafting: long-term item crafting projects\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Crafting\n  VALID_STATUSES = %w[active complete].freeze\n\n  def self.create_project(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_project(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      character_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [data[:character_id], campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless character_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_crafting_projects (id, campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, days_completed, cost_gp, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:character_id], data[:item_slug], data[:days_required], 0, data[:cost_gp], 'active']\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'character_id' => data[:character_id],\n        'item_slug' => data[:item_slug],\n        'days_required' => data[:days_required],\n        'days_completed' => 0,\n        'status' => 'active'\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.advance_project(campaign_id, project_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                             project_id.is_a?(String) && !project_id.empty?\n\n    days = payload['days']\n    return [:invalid] unless days.is_a?(Integer) && days > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, days_required, days_completed, status, item_slug FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE id = ? { |c| c['name'] == target }\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO combat_conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [session_id, target, condition, duration]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'conditions' => fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Conditions decrement at the *start* of a target's turn and are removed\n  # when their remaining duration drops to zero. The response echoes the full\n  # condition map so callers can see every combatant's state.\n  def self.advance_turn(session_id)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT round, turn_index, order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      round, turn_index, order_json = row\n      order = JSON.parse(order_json)\n      count = order.length\n\n      new_turn_index = (turn_index + 1) % count\n      new_round = round + (new_turn_index == 0 ? 1 : 0)\n\n      active_name = order[new_turn_index]['name']\n\n      d.execute('SELECT id, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ?', [session_id, active_name]).each do |cond_id, remaining_rounds|\n        new_remaining = remaining_rounds - 1\n        if new_remaining <= 0\n          d.execute('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?', cond_id)\n        else\n          d.execute('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_remaining, cond_id])\n        end\n      end\n\n      d.execute('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_round, new_turn_index, session_id])\n\n      conditions = order.each_with_object({}) { |c, h| h[c['name']] = [] }\n      d.execute('SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id', session_id).each do |target, condition, remaining_rounds|\n        conditions[target] ||= []\n        conditions[target] << { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => new_round,\n        'turn_index' => new_turn_index,\n        'active' => order[new_turn_index],\n        'conditions' => conditions\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.parse_combat_session(payload)\n    session_id = payload['id']\n    return nil unless session_id.is_a?(String) && !session_id.empty?\n\n    combatants = payload['combatants']\n    return nil unless combatants.is_a?(Array) && !combatants.empty?\n\n    parsed = combatants.map do |c|\n      return nil unless c.is_a?(Hash) &&\n                        c['name'].is_a?(String) && !c['name'].empty? &&\n                        c['dex'].is_a?(Integer) &&\n                        c['roll'].is_a?(Integer)\n\n      { name: c['name'], score: c['roll'] + c['dex'], dex: c['dex'] }\n    end\n\n    parsed.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:score], -c[:dex], c[:name]] }\n    order = parsed.map { |c| { 'name' => c[:name], 'score' => c[:score] } }\n\n    [session_id, order]\n  end\n  private_class_method :parse_combat_session\n\n  def self.fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n    d.execute(\n      'SELECT condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ? ORDER BY id',\n      [session_id, target]\n    ).map do |condition, remaining_rounds|\n      { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n    end\n  end\n  private_class_method :fetch_conditions_for_target\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Compendium: monsters and items\n#   type: type,\n      rarity: rarity,\n      cost_gp: cost_gp\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_item\nend\n\n# }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_character(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_character(payload)\n &&\n                           quest_id.is_a?(String) && !quest_id.empty?\n\n    completed = payload['completed']\n    return [:invalid] unless completed.is_a?(Array) && completed.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) }\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, status, milestones_json, completed_json FROM campaign_quests WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [quest_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      _, status, milestones_json, completed_json = row\n      milestones = JSON.parse(milestones_json)\n      done = JSON.parse(completed_json)\n\n      completed.each do |m|\n        done << m if milestones.include?(m) && !done.include?(m)\n      end\n\n      milestones_done = milestones.count { |m| done.include?(m) }\n      new_status = (milestones_done == milestones.length && milestones.length > 0) ? 'completed' : status\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE campaign_quests SET status = ?, completed_json = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_status, JSON.generate(done), quest_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => quest_id,\n        'status' => new_status,\n        'milestones_total' => milestones.length,\n        'milestones_done' => milestones_done\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.summary(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      active = 0\n      completed = 0\n      blocked = 0\n\n      d.execute('SELECT status FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id).each do |row|\n        status = row[0]\n        case status\n        when 'active' then active += 1\n        when 'completed' then completed += 1\n        when 'blocked' then blocked += 1\n        end\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'active' => active,\n        'completed' => completed,\n        'blocked' => blocked\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_quest(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    title = payload['title']\n    status = payload['status']\n    milestones = payload['milestones']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      title.is_a?(String) && !title.empty? &&\n                      status.is_a?(String) && VALID_STATUSES.include?(status) &&\n                      milestones.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      milestones.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) && !m.empty? }\n\n    {\n      id: id,\n      title: title,\n      status: status,\n      milestones: milestones,\n      completed: []\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_quest\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Factions and NPCs: campaign relationship tracking\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Factions\n  def self.create_faction(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_faction(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_factions WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_factions (id, campaign_id, name, stance) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:name], data[:stance]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'stance' => data[:stance]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_npc(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_npc(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      faction_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_factions WHERE id = ? AND f.stance = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'friendly']\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'factions' => factions,\n        'npcs' => npcs,\n        'friendly_npcs' => friendly_npcs\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_faction(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    stance = payload['stance']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      faction_id.is_a?(String) && !faction_id.empty? &&\n                      disposition.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    { id: id, name: name, faction_id: faction_id, disposition: disposition }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_npc\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Inventory and equipment: campaign inventory and character assignments\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Inventory\n  def self.add_item(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    item_slug = payload['item_slug']\n    quantity = payload['quantity']\n    owner = payload['owner']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless item_slug.is_a?(String) && !item_slug.empty? API — Codebase Guide\n\nA single-file Ruby HTTP server for a D&D 5e DM helper API. It uses only the\nRuby standard library plus SQLite, keeps all domain logic in named modules,\nand implements a tiny TCP/HTTP layer at the bottom of the file.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` is a one-line wrapper that executes `ruby server.rb`. The server\nbinds to `127.0.0.1` and reads the port from the `PORT` environment variable\n(defaulting to `3000`).\n\nVerify it is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nThe server runs in the foreground; stop it with `Ctrl-C` or by sending\n`SIGTERM` to the process.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n- `run.sh` — the launcher required by the harness.\n- `server.rb` — the only source file. It is organized from top to bottom as:\n  1. `Config` — constants (host, port, DB path, schema version).\n  2. `PureRules` — deterministic, side-effect-free game-rule helpers.\n  3. `Persistence` — SQLite schema, connection wrapper, and lifecycle helpers.\n  4. `Combat` — combat sessions, initiative, and turn/condition tracking.\n  5. `Compendium` — monster and item reference entries.\n  6. `Campaigns` — campaign metadata, characters, and event logs.\n  7. `Factions` — campaign factions, NPCs, and relationship summaries.\n  8. `Inventory` — campaign inventory and character equipment assignments.\n  9. `Crafting` — downtime crafting projects and progress.\n  10. `Auth` — PBKDF2 password hashing and user storage.\n  11. `PlayerHandbook` — PHB rule helpers (spell slots, rests, encumbrance).\n  12. `DmTools` — DM-facing helpers (encounter builder, loot, session recap).\n  13. `Sessions` — campaign session scheduling and attendance.\n  14. `Request` / `Response` / `Router` / `HttpServer` — transport layer.\n\nThe bottom of the file calls `HttpServer.run` when the file is executed\ndirectly.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence design\n\n- SQLite file: `game.db` in the working directory.\n- A single `Mutex` (`Persistence::DB_MUTEX`) serializes all database access.\n- `Persistence.db` yields a single shared `SQLite3::Database` connection that\n  is opened when the module loads and reused for the lifetime of the process.\n  This keeps the implementation simple and deterministic.\n- On startup the server calls `Persistence.initialize_schema!`. The schema\n  statements use `IF NOT EXISTS`, so existing data is preserved across restarts\n  and new tables are created automatically.\n- `Persistence.reset!` drops every application table and recreates the schema.\n  It is used by the `/v1/storage/reset` endpoint.\n\n### Request routing\n\n- Raw socket I/O: `TCPServer` accepts connections; each connection is handled\n  in its own thread so the accept loop is never blocked. `Request.parse`\n  reads a request line, headers, and optional body.\n- `Router.route` is a long `if/elsif` dispatch that matches `method + path`.\n  Path parameters are captured with anchored regexes and forced to UTF-8 so\n  SQLite binds them as text rather than blobs.\n- Connections are kept open until the client closes them, supporting HTTP/1.1\n  keep-alive without pipelining issues.\n- Domain modules return `[:tag, data]` tuples:\n  - `:ok` with a Hash body,\n  - `:invalid` for validation failures,\n  - `:not_found` for missing resources,\n  - `:conflict` for duplicate IDs.\n- `Router.handle_result` maps those tags to HTTP status codes (`200`, `201`,\n  `400`, `404`, `409`) and serializes the body as JSON.\n- Authentication endpoints (`/v1/auth/*`) are handled specially in the router\n  because `Auth` returns booleans rather than tuples. A successful login\n  returns a deterministic `session-<username>` token.\n\n## Main API/domain groupings\n\n| Group | Endpoints | Module |\n|-------|-----------|--------|\n| Core | `/health`, `/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`, `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order` | `PureRules` |\n| Characters | `/v1/characters/ability-modifier`, `/v1/characters/proficiency`, `/v1/characters/derived-stats` | `PureRules` |\n| Combat | `/v1/combat/sessions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/:id/conditions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/:id/advance` | `Combat` |\n| Auth | `/v1/auth/register`, `/v1/auth/login` | `Auth` |\n| Storage | `/v1/storage/status`, `/v1/storage/reset` | `Persistence` |\n| Compendium | `/v1/compendium/monsters`, `/v1/compendium/monsters/:slug`, `/v1/compendium/items`, `/v1/compendium/items/:slug` | `Compendium` |\n| Campaigns | `/v1/campaigns`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/characters`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/events`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/state` | `Campaigns` |\n| Factions | `/v1/campaigns/:id/factions`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/npcs`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/relationships` | `Factions` |\n| Inventory | `/v1/campaigns/:id/inventory`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/characters/:character_id/equipment`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/inventory/summary` | `Inventory` |\n| Session scheduling | `/v1/campaigns/:id/sessions`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/sessions/:session_id/attendance`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/sessions/next` | `Sessions` |\n| PHB rules | `/v1/phb/spell-slots`, `/v1/phb/rests/long`, `/v1/phb/equipment-load` | `PlayerHandbook` |\n| DM tools | `/v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `/v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `/v1/dm/session-recap` | `DmTools` |\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. If the endpoint is pure computation, put it in the appropriate domain\n   module (e.g., `PureRules`, `PlayerHandbook`, `DmTools`) and have it return\n   a Hash on success or `nil` on invalid input.\n2. If the endpoint needs persistence, add it to the module that owns the data\n   (e.g., `Combat`, `Campaigns`, `Compendium`) and return a `[:tag, data]`\n   tuple.\n3. Wire the endpoint into `Router.route` with an explicit `method`/`path` check\n   and call `handle_result` or `json_response` / `error_response` as needed.\n4. If the endpoint creates a resource, use status `201`; otherwise use `200`.\n\n### Adding a new table\n\n1. Add the `CREATE TABLE` statement to `Persistence::SCHEMA_SQL`.\n2. Add the table name to the drop list in `Persistence.reset!`.\n3. Add a module that owns reads and writes for that table.\n4. Keep validation logic private with `private_class_method`.\n\n### Testing locally\n\nBecause the server is a single file, you can run it directly:\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ruby server.rb\n```\n\nThen exercise endpoints with `curl` or any HTTP client.
